question: Which of the following semi-solid pharmaceutical forms with which a master formula can be prepared has greater occlusivity ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Hydrophobic ointments" -> "high lipid content" -> "forms barrier on skin" -> "prevents water loss" -> "greater occlusivity" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Hydrophobic or water-oily creams" -> "moderate lipid content" -> "partial barrier on skin" -> "some water loss prevention" -> "moderate occlusivity" -> 70%
CHAIN: "Hydrophilic or ole-aqueous creams" -> "low lipid content" -> "minimal barrier on skin" -> "limited water loss prevention" -> "low occlusivity" -> 60%
CHAIN: "Hydrophilic ointments" -> "water-based" -> "minimal barrier on skin" -> "does not prevent water loss" -> "low occlusivity" -> 50%
analysis: Occlusivity refers to the ability of a substance to form a barrier on the skin, preventing moisture loss. Hydrophobic ointments are typically more occlusive than creams, whether hydrophobic or hydrophilic, because they are oil-based and form a more effective barrier. Hydrophilic ointments, on the other hand, are less occlusive as they are designed to be more water-soluble.
